world.title: Video: Gunmen storm Jordan church during funeral, killing 7 and wounding 40 mourners
world.summary: Gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a church in Karak, Jordan, on Friday, resulting in at least seven fatalities and 40 injuries, according to authorities. The incident occurred in the southern city, approximately 180 kilometers south of the capital. Emergency services responded to the scene, and investigations are ongoing to identify the attackers and their motives.

world.title: Dan vs Daniel: Trump administration sues to block Alaska result if GOP candidate loses race
world.summary: The US Department of Justice has initiated a lawsuit to block the certification of Alaska's Senate election results if Republican Senator Dan Sullivan loses. This action follows former President Trump's criticism of Sullivan's opponent, Democrat Mary Peltola. The lawsuit underscores ongoing tensions within the Republican Party and raises questions about the integrity of the electoral process in Alaska.

world.title: Israel launches ‘limited counterterrorism’ operation after 2 IDF troops killed in West Bank
world.summary: The Israeli military initiated a "limited counterterrorism" operation in the Hebron area of the occupied West Bank after the deaths of two IDF troops. Residents in the operational areas can exit through three designated points. The military aims to address security concerns while minimizing civilian impact during the operation, which follows escalating violence in the region.

business.title: Upper layer NBFCs have to list: RBI governor on Tatas; dispels doubts on Sept order
business.summary: Reserve Bank of India Governor Sanjay Malhotra confirmed that upper layer non-banking financial companies (NBFCs) must remain listed, addressing concerns following the rejection of Tata Sons' attempt to exit its non-bank lender status. His remarks clarify the regulatory stance and respond to comments made by Noel Tata, chair of Tata Trusts, regarding the September order.

business.title: Two critical PHP flaws trigger global alert; millions of services face cyber risk
business.summary: Two critical vulnerabilities in PHP have raised a global cybersecurity alert, as they allow hackers to remotely execute code on servers without authentication. This poses significant risks to millions of internet services worldwide. Security experts are urging organizations to update their PHP versions promptly to mitigate potential exploitation and safeguard their systems against these vulnerabilities.

business.title: Tata Sons AGM deadline nears as Tata Trusts deadlock clouds voting
business.summary: Tata Sons is monitoring governance issues with its majority owners, Tata Trusts, as the annual general meeting (AGM) deadline approaches. Shareholder majority is needed for resolutions, and changes in trustee roles may significantly impact voting dynamics. Legal experts emphasize the importance of regulatory clarity and consensus among the trusts to ensure successful execution of the AGM and passing necessary resolutions.

technology.title: Will Apple Take Over Your (Smart) Home?
technology.summary: Apple is intensifying its efforts in the smart home market, raising questions about whether consumers will be willing to pay higher prices for its products compared to existing alternatives. The discussion also touches on ASML's semiconductor dominance, the impact of AI on demand and valuations, and the current situation in China, highlighting various market dynamics and challenges.

technology.title: iOS 27.1 Is Out Only for iPhone Duo: Other iPhones Skip to iOS 27.2
technology.summary: iOS 27.1 has been released exclusively for the iPhone Duo, while other iPhone models remain on iOS 27.0.1 and will upgrade directly to iOS 27.2. This means users of other iPhones will not receive iOS 27.1. According to reports, Apple is bypassing iOS 27.1 for most models, streamlining the update process for users.

technology.title: Touchscreen MacBook: Will Apple's upcoming event contradict Steve Jobs?
technology.summary: Apple is set to hold a “pro and tell” event next week, where it is expected to announce significant upgrades to the MacBook lineup. Reports suggest the introduction of a touchscreen option featuring an organic light-emitting diode display. This development may contradict a previous stance taken by co-founder Steve Jobs regarding touchscreen functionality in laptops.

sports.title: IND vs NZ: Shreyas Iyer on verge of breaking Rohit Sharma's unique T20I captaincy record
sports.summary: Shreyas Iyer is on the verge of breaking Rohit Sharma's T20I captaincy record. He has the opportunity to become India's highest run-scorer as T20I captain in a calendar year during the upcoming second match against New Zealand in their five-match series. This achievement would mark a significant milestone in Iyer's career as captain.

sports.title: ‘We need to be careful’
sports.summary: Charles Leclerc emphasized caution for Ferrari despite leading in Free Practice at the United States Grand Prix. He indicated that the team's recent upgrades may not be as effective as anticipated. Leclerc's comments suggest that maintaining their top position throughout the weekend could be challenging, as the Scuderia has implemented significant changes to their aerodynamic setup.

sports.title: Bodhana, 11, Breaks Judit Polgar’s Record To Become Youngest Female IM In History
sports.summary: Bodhana Sivanandan, an 11-year-old chess prodigy, has broken Judit Polgar’s 38-year record by becoming the youngest female International Master (IM) in history. She achieved this milestone by fulfilling the necessary requirements for the title, marking her as the seventh-youngest IM overall. This accomplishment highlights her exceptional talent and dedication to the game of chess.

health.title: Bharat Biotech slashes malaria vaccine price on GAVI-backed pact with UNICEF
health.summary: Bharat Biotech International announced a 40% price reduction for its malaria vaccine, Mosqivac, bringing the cost to €5.50 per dose. This decision follows a pact with UNICEF, supported by funding from Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance. The agreement aims to enhance access to the vaccine, facilitated by advance payments from the International Finance Facility for Immunisation (IFFIm).

health.title: Scientists Identify a New Type of Depression That May Feel Like Permanent Jet Lag
health.summary: A new study indicates that nearly 25% of depression patients may experience a form of chronic body clock disruption, resembling permanent jet lag. These individuals often sleep excessively, wake up feeling tired, and feel most alert during late hours. This condition highlights the complexity of depression, suggesting that it may involve significant disruptions to the body's circadian rhythms.

health.title: Can AI predict Cancer Survival Chance from a Single Selfie?
health.summary: Researchers at Mass General Brigham have developed an AI tool that analyzes facial features from a single selfie to predict cancer patients' survival chances. The system estimates biological age and mortality risk, potentially aiding doctors in assessing patient outcomes. This innovative approach could enhance personalized treatment plans, offering a new method for evaluating cancer prognosis based on visual data.

science.title: Mechanism behind PARP1-mediated DNA repair characterized, offering insight into targeted cancer therapy
science.summary: Scientists at St. Jude Children's Research Hospital have characterized a mechanism behind PARP1-mediated DNA repair, revealing insights into targeted cancer therapy. This research highlights the potential therapeutic benefits of inhibiting DNA damage repair in cancers with specific genetic vulnerabilities. The findings, published in Molecular Cell, may inform future strategies for cancer treatment by exploiting DNA damage response pathways.

science.title: Astronomer Jamie Williams Explains Newly Discovered ‘Phoenix’ Exoplanet Reborn From Its Star’s Ashes [Exclusive]
science.summary: Astronomers from the University of Warwick have discovered a unique second-generation exoplanet, termed the "Phoenix" planet, orbiting the white dwarf HS 0209+0832. This finding challenges existing planetary science conventions. Lead author Jamie Williams discussed the implications of this discovery, highlighting its significance in understanding planetary formation and evolution in the aftermath of a star's lifecycle.

science.title: NASA confirms plans to land astronauts on Moon…
science.summary: NASA has confirmed plans to land astronauts on the Moon in 2028 as part of the Artemis IV mission. This announcement was made by NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. The mission aims to further explore lunar capabilities and prepare for future missions. This initiative is part of NASA's broader goals for lunar exploration and sustainable presence on the Moon.

entertainment.title: Sami Zayn is the new alpha male of WWE
entertainment.summary: Sami Zayn, accompanied by Johnny Gargano and Candice LeRae, opened the October 23 episode of SmackDown with an in-ring promo, asserting his position as the true alpha male of WWE after a confrontation with Roman Reigns. However, another champion disagreed with Zayn's claim, setting the stage for potential future conflicts within the WWE hierarchy.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: October 24, 2026
entertainment.summary: On October 24, 2026, horoscopes suggest that individuals may question traditions and reassess their perceptions of love. For Pisces, Mercury retrograde may amplify these introspective thoughts, prompting discussions with others. The alignment of celestial bodies encourages reflection on personal beliefs and relationships, potentially leading to significant insights about self-worth and emotional connections.

entertainment.title: Leo Horoscope Today: October 24, 2026
entertainment.summary: Leos are advised to contemplate their next moves carefully, as significant developments are occurring beneath the surface. Recent decisions have been made thoughtfully, indicating a well-refined thought process. Exploration of different ideas is encouraged to navigate the complexities ahead. Overall, the horoscope suggests that Leos possess the capability to untangle challenges and make informed choices moving forward.
